advancements.chengjiu_001.title: Chengjiu 0 0 1
advancements.chengjiu_002.title: Chengjiu 0 0 2
advancements.chengjiu_002.descr: 一夜枯树老，千年古井寒。不知星河下，谁见此孤残。
advancements.chengjiu_003.title: Chengjiu 0 0 3
advancements.chengjiu_003.descr: 秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还。
advancements.chengjiu_004.title: Chengjiu 0 0 4
advancements.chengjiu_004.descr: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。
advancements.chengjiu_005.title: Chengjiu 0 0 5
advancements.chengjiu_005.descr: 千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。
advancements.chengjiu_006.title: Chengjiu 0 0 6
advancements.chengjiu_006.descr: 凭君莫话封侯事，一将功成万骨枯。
advancements.chengjiu_007.title: Chengjiu 0 0 7
advancements.chengjiu_007.descr: 曲径通幽处，禅房花木深。
advancements.chengjiu_008.title: Chengjiu 0 0 8
advancements.chengjiu_008.descr: 飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。
